guest.bio_context: Jonathan started his career in practice management consulting at National Financial Partners in 2007, working with wealth management firm owners across the country. After the financial crisis and a brief role at Charles Schwab, he transitioned to Fusion Advisor Network and later the Ensemble Practice under Philip Alvarez. He then moved to Lakeview Financial Group in Seattle as a client service associate, eventually becoming a lead advisor, before returning to Austin to join Austin Wealth Management and later founding his own independent RIA using XY Planning Network.
